Design Engineer, Volvo Construction Equipment
Would you like to help develop the construction equipment of the future? Together, we create world leading products in the premium segment, with a focus on quality, safety and care for the environment. We are looking for Design Engineers to join the Exterior department at Volvo Construction Equipment in Braås. This position is located on-site in Braås outside Växjö.
About us 
Volvo CE in Braås, near Växjö, developes articulated haulers and wheel loaders and manufactures articulated haulers. Our development departments are constantly working on innovative solutions and designs for new products. All to ensure that we remain at the forefront of development and pushing limits, regarding new product and feature development, product improvements and aftermarket quality.
You will join a global team of skilled professionals who work closely with colleagues in production, purchasing, aftermarket and also with our chosen suppliers. 
With production located at the same site, you will have the opportunity to follow your design solutions from development through to the finished product. 
About the role
As a Design Engineer, you will work with the mechanical design of components and solutions in plastics, sheet metal and tubular structures for wheel loaders and articulated haulers. You will contribute to product development and improvement work in collaboration with colleagues and other functions, taking responsibility for the quality of the team’s deliveries.You will work closely with Product Design in Gothenburg to bring new design languages to our machines. This calls for a strong understanding of plastics, sheet metal and tubular structures, and how to translate design concepts into functional, manufacturable solutions. You will also take the lead on design-related topics and act as a point of contact for other departments. By driving collaboration, coordinating discussions and working across functions, you will help ensure that the team’s deliverables are completed successfully. Your work will focus on exterior components for wheel loaders and articulated haulers.
Who are you?
You enjoy combining technical expertise with an open and solution-oriented approach. You are positive, flexible and a team player with an interest in innovation and product development. You are keen to learn and develop, both individually and as part of a team, and are willing to take the lead when needed. You are comfortable taking initiative and stepping forward when the situation calls for it. You communicate clearly and enjoy working across departmental boundaries, while taking responsibility for the team’s shared deliverables.
You have:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification
Experience in mechanical design
Strong communication skills in Swedish and English, both spoken and written
Experience with Creo or another 3D modelling tool

 
Experience or knowledge in any of the following areas is an advantage:
Construction equipment or heavy vehicles
Design of sheet metal, plastics or tubular components
FEM calculations
Lean and Agile ways of working

Ready for the next move?
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. Last application day November 29.

Are you passionate about test automation, cutting-edge technology, and building reliable solutions? Take on a key role in developing and improving quality assurance for advanced financial crime prevention platforms at one of the Nordic region’s largest banks. Join a collaborative team where your expertise in automation, data testing, and AI-driven testing approaches will make a real impact!
About the position
Perido are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer for our client, one of the largest banks in the Nordic region. The position is based at the bank’s office just north of Stockholm.
Your daily tasks
In this role, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of the platforms and detection capabilities used to prevent financial crime. The environment includes cloud-native data pipelines, rule-based detection, APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong test automation and data-testing expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches. You will work closely with developers, Business Analysts, Requirement Engineers, and architects to build quality into the development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a separate final step.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Python and/or Java and appropriate test automation frameworks
Apply AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches to improve test design, generation, execution, analysis, and maintenance
Test data pipelines, ETL processes, data quality, and data transformations across GCP
Validate rule-based detection engines and complex business logic used in Financial Crime Prevention
Test APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows across distributed systems
Define and continuously improve test strategy, regression coverage, integration testing, and end-to-end testing
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
Ensure AI-generated test assets and results are appropriately reviewed, validated, traceable, and reproducible
Identify quality risks early and work closely with the team to resolve them
Promote good testing practices and support the wider team in continuously improving quality engineering

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is analytical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a genuine interest in quality and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking initiative, solving complex problems and working independently, while also enjoying close collaboration with others. You have a structured approach to your work and the ability to communicate technical matters clearly to different stakeholders.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.
Qualifications:
8–10+ years of relevant experience in test automation, technical testing, quality engineering, or testing of complex software systems
Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing test automation solutions and frameworks
Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, together with good SQL knowledge
Practical experience with AI-assisted or agentic testing, including the use of AI or agents within the software testing lifecycle
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, preferably including technologies such as BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Composer
Strong experience in data, ETL, and data quality testing
Experience testing rule-based systems, decision engines, or complex business logic
Good understanding of APIs, system integrations, CI/CD, and end-to-end testing
Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand relationships between data, technology, business requirements, and controls
A proactive, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to take ownership and work effectively in a cross-functional agile team
Strong communication and documentation skills
A B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D., or equivalent relevant education and professional experience

 
Advantageous:
Experience within banking, Financial Crime Prevention, transaction monitoring, compliance, or another regulated environment
Experience applying AI-enabled development or testing tools in professional software engineering
ISTQB or similar testing certification
Google Cloud certification
Requirements Engineering certification, such as REQB or equivalent

The opportunity
This is a broad digital leadership role with responsibility for the systems and capabilities that support Lindex entire retail network. You have the opportunity to influence both operational reliability and the future development of the retail area.
The role combines a focused application portfolio with complex operational dependencies. A new point-of-sale system has recently been introduced and offers further development potential, while the continued establishment of new stores places clear demands on scalable processes and dependable infrastructure. You work closely with colleagues across Digital, Technology, Facilities, Properties and the wider business to turn retail priorities into sustainable digital solutions. You lead a multidisciplinary organisation that includes digital leads, developers and managers.
About the role
As Head of Digital – Retail, you hold strategic responsibility for the digital direction, capabilities and contribution to business performance across the company’s retail network. You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital solutions, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, profitability and long-term business success.
Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with business objectives and translated into tangible results. You lead digital development across the retail network, balancing reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement and future-focused innovation. By strengthening digital capabilities and embedding new technologies into retail operations, you enhance the employee and customer experience while driving efficiency and operational performance.
You also lead competence development in new digital capabilities and ways of working, strengthening Lindex digital maturity and ability to embrace future opportunities. Through collaboration across the organisation, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and long-term strategic ambitions.
The Head of Digital – Retail holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).
Key responsibilities
Define the digital direction, priorities and roadmap for the retail area.
Ensure stable operations and continuous improvement of point-of-sale systems, RFID solutions, the employee retail app and security gate systems.
Identify opportunities to improve retail processes, including pricing, product handling and the establishment of new retails.
Monitor system performance and lead effective incident management for business-critical retail solutions.
Coordinate digital requirements with Facilities and Properties to secure connectivity, fibre infrastructure and appropriate technical retail formats.
Balance operational stability, incremental improvements and the development of new digital capabilities.
Lead a team of developers, digital leads and managers.
Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Manegement Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation.
Collaborate across the organization to align retail priorities with Lindex overall business, digital and technology direction.
Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives.

About you
You understand the complexity of retail operations and recognise how even small changes in technology can have a significant operational impact. You combine curiosity about retail with sound judgement, structured prioritisation and the ability to turn business needs into workable digital solutions. You provide clarity across organisational boundaries and maintain a strong focus on stability, performance and continuous improvement.
To succeed in the role, you need:
A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
Extensive experience in digital development and technology within a business context.
Extensive leadership experience, including leading managers, employees or cross-functional teams.
Experience translating business strategy and operational needs into digital priorities, capabilities and execution.
Experience leading digital products, platforms, data, automation, agile delivery, objectives and key results, and backlog prioritisation.
Experience driving organisational change, transformation and continuous improvement.
Strong communication skills and fluency in English.

It is an advantage if you have:
Experience from retail and a strong understanding of day-to-day retail operations.
Experience with point-of-sale systems, RFID technology, retail applications or other retail-related platforms.
Experience with monitoring, incident management and business-critical technical infrastructure.
Experience leading across reporting lines and building trust with business and digital stakeholders.
Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.

The position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. International travel may be required.

jobs.occupation: Software Product Developer to Mycronic Pattern Generator
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing.
In this role, you will be part of a larger team of 18 people responsible for the software and data processing that enable the machines to carry out their operations. The team works across a wide range of areas, from applications and data conversion to operating systems, computer hardware and internal networks. A key part of the work involves preparing and processing large volumes of data, with high demands on performance and reliability. This role will give you a broad understanding of how software and hardware interact within a complex system. You are not expected to know everything from day one. Curiosity, a willingness to learn and the ability to collaborate with colleagues with different areas of expertise are just as important.
Work tasks
In this role, you will have the opportunity to combine new product development with problem-solving and the continuous improvement of existing systems. Your primary focus will be software development in Java, where you will contribute to enhancing existing features, modernising systems, and addressing technical challenges within an advanced product environment. Your responsibilities will also include troubleshooting issues reported by customers, testing on physical test systems, and optimising code where performance is critical.

Are you passionate about the intersection of Python programming, electronics, and radio frequency technology? In this role, you will play a key part in the core R&D organization, developing automated test sequences for next-generation digital coverage solutions and 5G infrastructure. Apply today, as we apply ongoing selection!

Our client develops patented, digital coverage solutions (Distributed Antenna Systems) engineered for demanding environments such as rail and road tunnels, subways, arenas, and large commercial venues. Their systems support commercial cellular networks from 2G up to 5G, as well as mission-critical public safety networks. In this position, you will join a specialized hardware development team of around six engineers at the global headquarters in Kista. The role is focused on the intersection of software and electronics: your primary mission is to build, maintain, and optimize automated RF test sequences and scripts in Python to verify products at both module and system level before they transition into series production. Because the position requires hands-on verification with instruments and test rigs in the laboratory, work is primarily conducted on-site in Kista, with the possibility of working remotely one day per week.
You will act as an essential link between internal R&D and manufacturing. Internally, you will collaborate daily with hardware, mechanics, and radio engineers, as well as a larger software development team. You will have no direct customer-facing duties; instead, your primary external stakeholders are production partners and manufacturing facilities in Sweden and Estonia. The role includes occasional travel—approximately 3 to 4 weeks per year—to install, configure, and troubleshoot test setups on-site at the manufacturing plants. You will become part of an open, supportive engineering culture characterized by flat hierarchies, shared daily fika breaks, and a transparent mindset where catching mistakes early and solving complex challenges together is valued above all else.
You are offered:
A technically versatile role working with cutting-edge 5G and cellular hardware solutions.
A tight-knit, collaborative team culture with short decision paths and high engineering expertise.
Occupational pension aligned with ITP1, wellness allowance, and free access to the building’s gym facilities.

Work tasks
Develop automated RF test sequences using Python, perform hardware lab verifications, and coordinate with production sites to ensure product quality.
Develop, maintain, and execute automated RF test sequences and scripts using Python.  
Perform test and verification at module and system levels on proprietary hardware and electronics.  
Set up and operate automated test equipment (ATE) and RF lab instruments, including spectrum analyzers and signal generators.  
Build, commission, and optimize automated test rigs for both laboratory development and factory production.  
Conduct lab-based hardware troubleshooting and analysis down to board and component levels.  
Collaborate closely with software and radio engineers to expand test coverage and streamline test cycles.  
Support external manufacturing partners and travel to production sites (approx. 3–4 weeks/year) to deploy and verify test setups.  
Document test methods, procedures, and test results within Jira and Confluence.

We are looking for
An academic degree in Electrical Engineering, Wireless Communication, Applied Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.
At least 1 year of documented professional experience in Python programming for automation, scripting, or hardware test control - either from your education or previous work experience.
Practical hands-on experience working with RF test instrumentation (e.g., spectrum analyzers, signal generators) or Automated Test Equipment (ATE).
Good technical understanding of cellular standards such as LTE (4G) and 5G NR.
Comfort working in Linux environments and performing hands-on lab work.
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as it is used in technical documentation and manufacturing communication.
This position requires that you hold a valid work permit or have the legal right to work in Sweden.

It is meritorious if you have
Experience reading electronic schematics and circuit diagrams.
Knowledge of database management and SQL.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and project tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Practical experience with hardware prototyping platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi).

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Intellectually curious
Respectful

jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian at University Animal Hospital, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination.
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. We would also like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of tomorrow and provide high-quality care for companion animals, competition animals and farm animals. We also share knowledge with the wider public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are helping to shape the future of veterinary care.
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.

jobs.occupation: Grants Officer for the Africa Region
jobs.description:
About the Tenure Facility
The Tenure Facility is the first and only international financial mechanism exclusively focused on securing land and forest rights for Indigenous Peoples and local communities worldwide. Recognizing and upholding these rights represents one of the most impactful opportunities for fostering sustainable rural development, achieving global climate goals, and mitigating local conflicts in a cost-effective manner.
Through grants and technical assistance, the Tenure Facility empowers Indigenous Peoples and local communities by strengthening their capacity to implement land and forest tenure reforms. Additionally, it supports governments in testing and scaling innovative approaches to land rights recognition, ensuring practical solutions to administrative and legal challenges.
Overview of the Position
The Grants Officer reports to the Chief Operating Officer and forms part of the Operations Team. The Grants Officer plays a key role in the implementation of the Tenure Facility’s grant-making and grant supervision processes. He or she will be responsible for administering the grant processes of the Tenure Facility’s projects and for ensuring that Tenure Facility staff members, consultants, and project partners operate within existing policies, guidelines, and procedures.
While the position falls under the Operations Team, given its strong programmatic focus, the Grants Officer is expected to work in close coordination with the Program Officers and the Finance Unit. The position may involve in-country visits to project partners.
Overarching Responsibilities
Contribute to establishing the Tenure Facility as a highly credible and respected foundation among international development institutions and donors.
Generate mutual trust and respect with Indigenous Peoples and local communities and their cultures, with full awareness of the intricacies of relationships among them and their allies and supporters.
Contribute to a collaborative and resilient internal working culture that supports sustained progress toward the Tenure Facility’s strategic goals and objectives.

Specific Responsibilities
The main responsibilities include:
Ensure that data related to grants and grantees in the Project Management System (Roots) is complete and meets Tenure Facility standards.
Work with Program Officers to provide prompt and sensitive responses to all unsolicited requests for funding and record related information.
Track the progress of project preparation, implementation, disbursement, reporting, and closure in Roots, and prepare related reports for management, donors, communications, and other stakeholders.
Coordinate the procurement of consultants and programme-related services, assist in preparing consultant contracts, ensure compliance with foundation regulations, and handle related queries, invoices, and payments.
Draft grant management documents, such as grant agreements, extensions, and amendments, for review by Program Officers and Financial Controllers, and manage related correspondence with grantees.
Review grant concept notes, proposals, risk registers, quality assurance reviews, and grant agreements to ensure they are complete and aligned with Tenure Facility policies.
Ensure the timely submission and approval of grantee reports by tracking and monitoring their status and sending reminders to grantees.
Shepherd grants and contracts through the review and approval process.
Assist with grant payment schedules, disbursements, and monitoring grant balances in coordination with Financial Controllers.
Assist with programme-related travel preparations and ensure reports are created and registered in TF systems.
Train new programme staff on grants and contracts processes and the use of the Project Management System (Roots).
Advise Tenure Facility staff members, consultants, and grantees on policies and procedures related to grant management.
Work to enhance and improve grants management processes and increase efficiency.
Undertake special projects as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements
University degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in international development, law, business or public administration, social sciences, natural resource management, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an asset.
Minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in grants management, programme operations or administration, or project management, preferably with a foundation, international NGO, donor agency, or similar organisation.
Experience working with partners in Africa, and with Indigenous Peoples and local communities, is a strong asset.
Experience with grants management or similar information systems; familiarity with NGO Online (DigiPING) is an asset.
Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken, is required.
Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish would be considered an asset.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly, including to project sites and partner organisations in Africa, sometimes in remote locations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and online collaboration tools.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multicultural, geographically distributed team, with cultural sensitivity and respect for Indigenous Peoples and local communities.

Terms of Employment
Permanent full-time position, starting 7 January 2027, with a six months' probationary period.
Location: Kungsholmen, Stockholm.
Collective agreement, pension and insurance: Almega Tjänstemannaavtalet.
Salary by agreement.

jobs.occupation: 5G RAN System Engineer / Baseband System Developer
jobs.description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
TECHLA is now looking for an experienced system profile within 5G RAN/Baseband for an exciting consulting assignment in Gothenburg. This role is a great fit for someone with a strong technical interest in radio systems, communication theory, signal processing and the development of functionality in modern mobile networks.
About the role
In this role, you will work with system development within 5G RAN, focusing on developing, analyzing and improving the performance of baseband-related functionality. The work may include areas such as radio resource management, scheduling, link adaptation, time-critical communication, antenna control and optimization of 5G network performance.
You will work closely with development, design and test teams and be involved throughout the development chain, from early ideas, analysis and specification to implementation, verification and deployment of new features.
Examples of responsibilities:
Design and specification of algorithms within RAN/Baseband
 Systemization and requirements breakdown for new base station features
 Analysis and optimization of 5G network performance
 Work related to radio resources, scheduling, link adaptation and antenna control
 Support to design and test teams throughout the development process
 Analysis of fault reports and technical issues on system level
 Contribute to the development of new features from early concept to customer-facing product environments

We believe you have
Experience from 5G RAN, Baseband or similar telecom systems
 Good understanding of 3GPP-based communication systems, such as 3G, 4G/LTE and 5G NR
 Experience from the lower layers of the protocol stack, such as L1/L2, PHY or MAC
 Knowledge within communication theory, signal processing or radio algorithms
 Experience from system work, algorithm design, technical analysis or performance optimization
 The ability to understand complex technical problems and drive them forward
 Good English skills, both spoken and written

It is meritorious if you have
Previous experience from Ericsson, Combitech or another RAN/Baseband-related environment
 Experience with scheduling, link adaptation, RRM, MIMO, beamforming or antenna control
 Experience with Python, C, MATLAB or similar tools for analysis, simulation or performance evaluation
 A Master of Science or Ph.D. within Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Computer Science, Telecom, Communication Technology or a similar field
 Experience using AI tools in technical development work
 Swedish language skills

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

Company description:
At Epiroc, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our vision is clear: we aim to accelerate the transformation of mining towards a greener and more sustainable industry. In this role, you’ll get the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art mobile machines, electric drivetrains, and control systems that are moving towards higher degrees of automation and sophistication. 
Job description:Are you ready to shape the future of mining equipment systems in a rapidly evolving industry? Join our dynamic team as a System Engineer and play a crucial role in optimizing the performance, reliability, and efficiency of the complete machine system integrated into our products. 
Join our team 
Our aspiration is to produce the world’s greenest machines using the world’s greenest materials. We are leading the charge towards a more sustainable future through battery-electric, zero-emission mining equipment. Are you ready to be part of this journey? Join our fantastic team of engineers and play a pivotal role in advancing mining technology while pushing boundaries on performance, reliability, and efficiency. 
Your mission 
Your mission as a system engineer is to develop and adapt our machine systems in terms of hardware, system architecture, and functionality to fulfill requirements regarding e.g., performance, availability, and safety. Drive concept development from ideation through requirements decomposition and specification, including trade-off studies, to design, implement, and execute verification and validation of the technical solution, ensuring an efficient and traceable end-to-end development loop. 
You will primarily work in project form with new product development projects, product maintenance, technology development, and customer orders. You will have close contact with other departments in Örebro, for example service, purchasing and marketing, as well as contact with customers and suppliers around the world. Furthermore, you will contribute to the building of modularized solutions, process improvement, and team competence assets. 
Your profile 
You have a university degree in a relevant area. We believe you have professional experience within system engineering or other highly qualified engineering background. You are used to bringing ideas from concept to serial production and are familiar with requirement management tools such as Doors or Polarion or similar. You have proven experience in modularization and systems engineering practices such as MBSE (Model based system engineering), and hands-on experience with Matlab tools and Hopsan. You also have a solid understanding of software, including control systems and system architectures, as well as CAN communication protocols (J1939, CAN Open). Knowledge of software development and electrical systems, and experience with CAD, simulation, and other software tools are considered a plus. 
To enjoy the work you are self-propelled, responsible, and your work is effectively planned to meet deadlines with the right quality. You have a structured and analytical approach, enjoy combining theory and practice, and strive to get the job done to our customers' satisfaction. Furthermore, you have good interpersonal skills, enjoy teamwork, and thrive in a collaborative environment where communication is key. Technical project management experience or R&D leadership experience is a plus. Since your work includes many local and global contacts, it is required that English skills (verbal and written) are fluent and that you understand Swedish. 
Life at Epiroc 
By joining our team, you can expect an atmosphere of creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. You will be a part of a group of skilled and helpful colleagues who live by our core values: Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation. We work in a global environment with 120 different nationalities! 
In addition to the fact that we have a culture that is characterized by development combined with having a good balance between work and leisure, there are some things that makes us a little extra proud to work at Epiroc:   
Global career opportunities, Epiroc University, for your own competence development, Community involvement, benefits package, which amongst other things include flexible working hours and bonus. 
Life at Epiroc can include the possibility for a hybrid workplace. It is a way of working that offers flexibility to partly work from home, based on your role, responsibilities, and individual conditions.  
Location and travel 
This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. 
Application and contact 
We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible by creating an account in our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. The last day to apply for this position is November 22nd 2026. 
Hiring manager: Xi Yang, Group Manager R&D,

Maria Roseen, +46702590507, maria.x.roseen@external.epiroc.com,

Company Description

Job Description
About the Role
Are you passionate about sustainable technology and modern software engineering? Join our cross-functional team in developing the next generation of energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions. In this role, you will help design, implement, and optimize intelligent control and regulation algorithms for state-of-the-art heat pumps, directly contributing to the global energy transition.

Your contribution
Shape the future: Develop control and regulation functions for our latest heat pumps, actively driving forward innovative algorithms for energy-efficient, resource-saving heating and cooling systems.
Take a holistic approach: Guide software functions throughout their full lifecycle—from requirements gathering and concept simulation through to implementation and verification across multiple testing levels (MIL, SIL, HIL).
Realize model-based software: Design and optimize model-based software functions in Matlab/Simulink for the closed-loop control of thermodynamic and hydraulic systems.
Implement software: Apply modern software development practices and text-based languages (e.g., C/C++), utilizing modern engineering and AI-assisted tools to advance embedded software modules.
Validate & test: Commission and test application software on cutting-edge heat pump test benches, supporting rapid prototyping and real-world system validation.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work in an international, agile environment, collaborating closely with experts across software, electronics, HMI, hydraulics, and thermodynamics.

Qualifications
What You Bring
Education: Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Mechatronics, Control Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical engineering background).
Core Competencies:
Solid foundational understanding of control engineering, mechatronic systems, or thermodynamic processes.
Practical experience in software development—either through model-based development (Matlab/Simulink) or text-based embedded programming (C/C++).
Working familiarity with software testing or simulation concepts (e.g., MIL, SIL, or HIL).
Languages: Working proficiency / business fluency in English (written and spoken).
Mindset: Solution-oriented mindset, strong curiosity for clean energy technologies, and an eagerness to learn and grow within an international team.

Nice to Have
Several years of dedicated industry experience in embedded software or controls engineering.
Knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration cycles, or hydraulic systems.
Experience with bus protocols and communication interfaces (e.g., CAN, LIN, Modbus, MQTT).
Familiarity with agile development practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and modern CI/CD tooling (e.g., Git, Jira, Jenkins).

Additional Information
What We Offer
Impactful Mission: Play an active role in decarbonization and sustainable climate technologies.
Flexible Working: Flexible working hours and hybrid work options for an optimal work-life balance.
Continuous Growth: Access to cutting-edge development tools, AI tooling, and tailored technical/language training opportunities.
Collaborative Culture: An open, appreciative, and international team environment with state-of-the-art laboratory and test bench facilities.
